title: Log Investigator JSONL event input (jsonl-v1)
description: One UTF-8 JSON object per line. The parser additionally validates timezone-aware ISO 8601 dates, encodable Unicode scalar values, finite JSON numbers, serialized attributes <=8192 UTF-8 bytes, source lines <=32768 bytes and complete files <=10485760 bytes.

timestamp.description: A datetime accepted by Python datetime.fromisoformat, with a non-null UTC offset; terminal Z is accepted. Semantic parsing rejects invalid or timezone-naive values.

attributes.description: Finite JSON values; json.dumps(attributes, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) encoded as UTF-8 must not exceed 8192 bytes.
